evidenceRules: Source evidence at a real address is distinct from a generic interface or upstream repository.
Explorer implementations are current lookup metadata, not a historical implementation-slot proof.
Historical block hashes plus authorityFingerprint/evidenceHash do not by themselves bind contract runtime code.
owner/referral/fee recipient are not output receiver unless the implementation sends this operation output there.
Protocol-level independent flash entrypoints do not confer deferred-input capability on a different selected Family operation.
Native withdrawTo does not directly produce WETH at an arbitrary address.
Unknown is not unsupported and cannot satisfy the new adaptation-pass gate.
Existing historical ordinary-operation receipts do not prove the new distinct-recipient mode or current changed source.

adaptationPassGateRequirements.require: Every projected direction and implemented variant has an explicit supported/unsupported/unverified status for caller deferred, input-first callback, internal hook, and selected receiver.

Bind chainId, target, historical block number/hash, proxy/implementation or beacon/module relationship, runtime code hashes and verified implementation source hashes. Unknown historical upgrade/dependency identity is not pass.
Record selector, payer, input debit/burn timing, output receiver, callback target, callback authentication, and debt/invariant validation. Keep independent flash entrypoints separate.

A supported mode must be implemented, truthfully declared and consumed under its actual restrictions. An unsupported mode must fail closed. Accepted per-instance behavior must not be replaced by an address allowlist.

Match actual current Family/executor source bytes to saved or newly authorized local-fork/REVM evidence for distinct caller/owner/receiver; exact input debit; fresh recipient output; old inventory; wrong receiver/callback; relevant fee/permission/cooldown/rounding variants. Interface presence alone is not execution pass.
Historic interface findings remain historic; current proxy, hook, registry and permission state must be source-bound again where mutable.
